title: Worksheet 4: In-Game Chat (V2.0)
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: Many Roblox games include a chat feature that lets players send typed messages to each other, and some games also allow voice chat, where players can talk out loud using a microphone. Chat features can make games more fun by letting players work together, but they can also be used by some people to say unkind things, share inappropriate content, or try to convince a player to do something unsafe. Roblox has automatic filters that are designed to block certain inappropriate words or personal information, such as phone numbers, from being sent through chat. However, these filters are not perfect, and some people try to trick the filters by misspelling words or using symbols instead of letters. Because of this, it is still important for players to pay attention to what is being said in chat, avoid responding to messages that feel wrong, and tell a trusted adult if chat messages seem inappropriate, even if a filter did not catch them.

questions.text: According to the paragraph, voice chat lets players:
questions.correct: Talk out loud using a microphone

questions.text: According to the paragraph, what are Roblox's automatic filters designed to block?
questions.correct: Certain inappropriate words and personal information, such as phone numbers
distractors: Every message from a new player
Any message longer than one sentence

questions.text: According to the paragraph, how do some people try to trick the filters?
questions.correct: By misspelling words or using symbols instead of letters

questions.text: According to the paragraph, what should a player do if chat messages seem inappropriate?
questions.correct: Tell a trusted adult, even if a filter did not catch them
distractors: Repeat the message to see if it gets blocked
Wait to see if the person says it again
Turn the game off and say nothing

questions.text: A player sees a message that got past the filter and assumes it must be allowed. Based on the paragraph, why is that assumption wrong?
questions.correct: The filters are not perfect, so getting through does not mean a message is okay
distractors: Only voice chat is filtered by Roblox
Messages are reviewed by a person first
